qa_pairs.question: What is Career Point University Kota, and how established is it?
qa_pairs.ideal_answer: Career Point University (CPU), Kota is one of the top self-financed private universities in Rajasthan. It has 14+ years of academic excellence and is backed by the 33-year legacy of the Career Point Group. It positions itself as an 'AI-First University,' integrating AI learning across all its programs, and is NAAC accredited and UGC approved.
qa_pairs.supporting_context: Career Point University (CPU), Kota is a leading institution with 14+ years of academic excellence, backed by the 33-year legacy of Career Point Group. As an AI-First University, CPU integrates industry-relevant AI learning across all programs, ensuring students are prepared for the future from day one.

entries.question_english: I have only given NEET, not JEE. Can I still get admission into B.Tech at CPU? Do NEET students face any problem getting into B.Tech here?
entries.question_hinglish: Maine sirf NEET diya hai, JEE nahi diya. Kya mujhe CPU mein B.Tech mein admission mil sakta hai? Kya NEET wale bachon ko yahan B.Tech mein admission lene mein koi dikkat aati hai?
entries.ideal_answer: For general context: NEET is normally the entrance exam used for medical/health-science programs (like MBBS, BDS, B.Pharm), while B.Tech admissions are usually based on JEE or a university's own entrance/merit criteria — the two exams are not typically interchangeable. However, this specific website content does not state whether CPU accepts NEET scores for B.Tech, or what CPU's exact B.Tech eligibility/entrance requirement is (JEE score, board-marks merit, or a CPU entrance test). So it cannot be confirmed from this content whether a NEET-only student would face any issue with B.Tech admission. The safest step is to call the Admission HelpDesk at +91-9079134713 or use the 'Apply Online' link and ask directly about B.Tech eligibility. If the goal is a medical/health-related degree instead, CPU's School of Health & Allied Sciences may be the more relevant option to ask about.
